annotations.title: Rules and limits of one commercial mortgage program

description: Everything published about one commercial mortgage program: eligible property types and loan purposes, minimum and maximum loan, maximum LTV and LTC, minimum DSCR and debt yield, term, amortization, rate type, recourse, prepayment, timeline, today's indicative rate, who it fits and who should look elsewhere, and the programs to compare it with. Every figure carries its as-of date and primary source (Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, HUD, SBA, eCFR, SEC filings and others). Limits that are not published say so.
